name: Manual Secure Code Review
description: Manual review of source code for security vulnerabilities across common languages (Java, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, C#, Go). Covers taint analysis, input validation, injection sinks, memory safety, and language-specific vulnerability patterns.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to secure code review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands common vulnerability patterns in source code
evidence: Can explain common vulnerability classes (injection, buffer overflow, deserialization)
Familiar with OWASP Code Review Guide concepts
Understands source-sink analysis at a conceptual level

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews code for basic vulnerability patterns under supervision
evidence: Identified injection and input validation flaws in guided code review exercises
Reviewed code in at least 2 languages under supervision
Used IDE navigation and search to trace data flow
Findings reviewed and validated by authorized reviewer

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews codebases and identifies security vulnerabilities
evidence: Independently completed 5+ secure code review engagements
Reviews code in at least 3 languages for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities
Performs source-to-sink taint tracing for injection vulnerabilities
Produces clear findings reports with code references and remediation
Passed proficiency assessment on manual code review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Reviews complex codebases; identifies subtle logic and design flaws
evidence: Identifies race conditions, TOCTOU, and concurrency vulnerabilities
Reviews framework-specific patterns and custom security implementations
Identifies design-level vulnerabilities beyond implementation bugs
Mentors junior reviewers on code review methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on secure code review; develops methodology and training
evidence: Published research on code vulnerability patterns or novel code flaws
Developed the lab's code review methodology and checklists
Reviews code in 5+ languages with deep knowledge of language-specific flaws
Trains teams on secure code review techniques

assessment_methods.description: Review a prepared codebase with seeded vulnerabilities and produce a findings report within a time limit
Review of findings quality and completeness from 3 recent code review engagements
